response.sql: WITH phase_stats AS (SELECT o."lunarstage", AVG(t."bandusagepct") AS avg_bandusage, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM "telescopes" AS t JOIN "observatories" AS o ON t."observstation" = o."observstation" GROUP BY o."lunarstage"), phase_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_bandusage) AS mean_phase_avg FROM phase_stats) SELECT AVG(p.avg_bandusage) AS kept_phases_avg_bandusage, SUM(p.telescope_count) AS kept_phases_telescope_count, AVG(p.avg_bandusage - m.mean_phase_avg) AS avg_excess_above_mean FROM phase_stats AS p CROSS JOIN phase_mean AS m WHERE p.avg_bandusage > m.mean_phase_avg

assumptions.assumption: A phase with no non-NULL bandwidth values has a NULL average and is excluded from the above-mean phases; phase averages and the mean across them ignore NULLs, following SQL AVG semantics.
